title: GBA Fire Emblem text font metrics (fonts/<name>.json)
description: A text font (decomp TextGlyphs_* tables): 'image' is a 16x16-cell PNG atlas next to this file whose pixel indices 0..3 are the glyph's 2bpp values (0 = background); the cell of character code c is column c % 16, row c / 16. 'glyphs' lists only codes that have a glyph, with their advance width in pixels.

game.description: Game whose ROM the font was extracted from (docs/decisions/0010-multi-game-reuse.md).
